name: pitch-plugin
description: The pitch plugin: apply to a design role by building an on-brand prototype for the company instead of sending a resume.

plugins.name: pitch
plugins.description: Spearfish a design role: research the company and everything it already offers, audit their UX, extract their design system, run futures work and pick one concept, build a tasteful on-brand prototype and walk through it click by click, state the thesis, write the note. Six stages, one sub-agent each, your approval after every stage, then straight on to the next.
